notes.title: The Island Story is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The Island Story is now available! During the release week, you could buy the game with a 10% off discount.

In this relax game, you play as the god of an island. Customize the plants and animals to make a unique island belongs to your own.

Hope you will enjoy!
